title: Async collection
purpose: Find records while understanding loading, empty and failure states.
useWhen: Records arrive asynchronously and can be searched or refreshed.
avoidWhen: Use static content for a known local list; use pagination when the service requires it.
alternatives: Use static content for a known local list; use pagination when the service requires it.
transitions: initial-loading → populated or empty or failure
query change → loading → results or no-results
applicability: Records arrive asynchronously and can be searched or refreshed.
exceptions: Require only states supported by the application; do not fabricate capabilities.
